findings.obs_text: In the narratives and sayings of Gen 20:11, Gen 26:9, Gen 31:31, Gen 32:20, Exo 2:14, Jos 22:28, Judg 3:24, Judg 15:2, Rut 4:4, 1Sa 16:6, 1Sa 18:11, 1Sa 18:17, 1Sa 18:21, 1Sa 20:26, 2Sa 14:15, 2Sa 14:17, 2Sa 21:16, 2Ki 5:11, 2Ki 20:19, Job 29:18, Psa 94:18, Isa 39:8, Jer 3:7, Jer 3:19 and Eze 20:32 thought carries H0559, to say, and the thought is given as the quoted words a person said within. Small words of the units are H3588A in Gen 20:11 and H0834A in Eze 20:32.
findings.grounds: I thought that you would take your daughters

findings.obs_text: Thought carries Hebrew verbs of reckoning, devising, likening, remembering and discerning: H2803J in Gen 38:15 and Psa 73:16, H2803I in 1Sa 18:25 and Psa 40:17, H1819 in Num 33:56, Psa 48:9 and Psa 50:21, H5869I in 2Sa 3:19, H2142 in Lam 1:9, H0995 in Pro 14:15 and Pro 21:29 (with H1931). The thought is a judgment, a plan, a likening or attention given.
findings.grounds: the prudent gives thought to his steps

findings.obs_text: Thought as a noun of what the mind holds: H1697G with H1961 in Deu 15:9 (an unworthy word in the heart), H4284 in 1Ch 28:9 (every plan and thought the Lord understands), H6248 in Job 12:5, H2808 in Ecc 9:10, H7808 in Amo 4:13. In Jon 1:6 H6245B is the god giving a thought, with H0194 perhaps; in Mic 2:8 H7725G is turning back, not a thought.
findings.grounds: an unworthy thought in your heart

findings.obs_text: In the Gospels and Acts thought carries G1380 (Mar 6:49, Luk 24:37, Joh 11:13, Joh 13:29, Act 12:9), G3543 (Mat 20:10, Act 8:20) and G2919 (Act 26:8): a view taken of what is so, which the verse shows mistaken or in question. In Luk 12:17 it carries G1260 with G3004G, the rich man reasoning to himself.
findings.grounds: they thought it was a ghost

findings.obs_text: In 1Cor 13:11 thought carries G5426, the child's mindedness; in 2Cor 9:5 and Phili 2:25 G2233, a judgment of what is necessary; in 2Cor 10:5 G3540, every thought taken captive; in 1Ti 3:7 G3141, a good report from outsiders, not a thought.
findings.grounds: take every thought captive to obey Christ
